Near-complete current national law: 3,689 Lilex texts (1,239 national acts and ordinances plus 2,450 treaties), including the Constitution and all six main codes, with text matching gesetze.li word for word in the checks; but only the Constitution, VRG and StGHG have in-force history, and no court decisions are held at all.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
